name: Strike
design_note: Baseline. Every other action is measured against this.

name: Ember
design_note: Starter. Hits RES; full power from the back rank.

name: Magibolt
design_note: Starter magic. A bolt of raw spirit; hits RES and scales with Spirit affinity.

name: Pierce
design_note: Ignores 75% DEF but slow. Wins vs armour only. S6.0 exemplar.

name: Flurry
design_note: 3 hits each rolling crit. Best keen target.

name: Execute
crit_dynamic: +0.65 at foe HP<=30% else crit forced to 0
design_note: v2.8 payoff is CRIT not power. Power flat and HP-independent.

name: Cripple
design_note: Slowed - 33% fewer enemy turns. Best non-heal rule.

name: Brace
design_note: Fast high charge. Fastest action in the game.

name: Vengeance
power_dynamic: 0.55 at full HP rising to 2.10 near death

name: Rally
design_note: Doubles charge rate. Highest charge gain.

name: Gale
design_note: All foes magic - safe vs thorns.

name: Smother
design_note: Dulled - cuts enemy MAG and healing.

name: Cinder Strike
design_note: Elemental grid (v2.13): one atk + one mag action per element, so every element gets a physical option for the first time (previously element tags lived on MAG_CAMP only). Split across rarities so no element clusters in one tier - Fire is atk-Common/mag-Rare. Common: power flat, same shape as Strike.

name: Firebrand
design_note: Elemental grid. Fire's second mag action alongside Ember/Sear. Rare: power scaled up 25% over Ember's baseline (RARITY_POWER_MUL.rare).

name: Riptide Blow
design_note: Elemental grid. Water is atk-Rare/mag-Legendary. Rare: power scaled up 25% over Strike's baseline.

name: Tidal Surge
design_note: Elemental grid. Legendary: power scaled up 55% over Ember's baseline (RARITY_POWER_MUL.legendary).

name: Quake Bolt
design_note: Elemental grid. Earth's first mag action - MAG_CAMP had zero Earth coverage before this. Earth is atk-Legendary/mag-Common. Common: power flat, same shape as Ember.

name: Stoneshatter
design_note: Elemental grid. Legendary: power scaled up 55% over Strike's baseline.

name: Squall Strike
design_note: Elemental grid. Air's first atk action (Gale is mag-only). Air is atk-Common/mag-Rare. Common: power flat, same shape as Strike.

name: Zephyr Bolt
design_note: Elemental grid. Air's second mag action alongside Gale. Rare: power scaled up 25% over Ember's baseline.

name: Radiant Blow
design_note: Elemental grid. Light's first atk action (Dazzle is mag-only). Light is atk-Rare/mag-Legendary. Rare: power scaled up 25% over Strike's baseline.

name: Solar Flare
design_note: Elemental grid. Legendary: power scaled up 55% over Ember's baseline.

name: Shadow Rend
design_note: Elemental grid. Dark's first atk action (Hex/Siphon are mag-only). Dark is atk-Legendary/mag-Common. Legendary: power scaled up 55% over Strike's baseline.

name: Umbral Bolt
design_note: Elemental grid. Dark's third mag action alongside Hex/Siphon. Common: power flat, same shape as Ember.

name: Wayfarer's Oath
design_note: CHARGE - {{name}}. Single burst. Highest power in the game. Rare: power and crit bonus scaled up 25%.

name: Ninefold Rain
design_note: CHARGE - Vey. Multi-hit random targeting. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Hearthlight
design_note: CHARGE - Ansa. Party heal + cleanse. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Vow of Stone
design_note: CHARGE - Dorrek. Party buff + taunt. Rare: no power field to scale (buff-only).

name: Ashfall
design_note: CHARGE - Mirel. AoE damage + DoT. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Bloodfury
design_note: CHARGE - Skarn (roster expansion). Big single-target hit, heavy crit bonus, partial lifesteal - a reckless crit-fisher that sustains itself. Rare: power and crit bonus scaled up 25%.

name: Spellbrand
design_note: CHARGE - Sorin (roster expansion). Armor-piercing blade strike that sears the target Frail - melee delivery, magic payload. Rare: power and defPierce scaled up 25%.

name: Warding Curse
design_note: CHARGE - Nyra (roster expansion). Light AoE damage plus Enfeebled on every foe - shuts down enemy offense from the back line. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Aegis Step
design_note: CHARGE - Brenn (roster expansion). Self Blurred (+0.20 evade) plus self-taunt - draws every attack, then dodges most of them. The dodge-tank answer to Vow of Stone. Rare: no power field to scale (buff-only).

name: Quicksilver Blessing
design_note: CHARGE - Sael (roster expansion). Light party heal plus Hasted - trades raw healing for tempo. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Heavy Strike
design_note: CHARGE - MC generic starter (roadmap item 2). Bulk physical damage to one foe. No status/lifesteal/condition - the plain baseline pick.

name: Wildfire
design_note: CHARGE - MC generic starter. Bulk magic damage to all foes. No status/lifesteal/condition - the plain baseline pick.

name: Great Heal
design_note: CHARGE - MC generic starter. Heals the whole party. No status/lifesteal/condition - the plain baseline pick.

name: Wearing Down
design_note: CHARGE - MC generic starter. Physical damage to one foe plus Enfeebled - power scales off the average of ATK and MAG for a build that doesn't lean hard into either camp.

name: Iron Resolve
design_note: CHARGE - MC generic starter. Shields one ally - heal plus Bracing (DEF up) - scales off the average of ATK and MAG same reasoning as Wearing Down.

name: Reckless Blow
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop (stat-scaling set). Scales off own ATK, not camp-implied MAG. Heavy single-target hit with a big crit bonus. Rare: power and crit bonus scaled up 25%.

name: Arcane Lance
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Scales off own MAG. Piercing magic strike that ignores 20% RES. v2.19: the Piercing Lore bonus used to be dead on it (camp==='atk' only) - now stacks with the built-in defPierce like any physical action. Rare: power and defPierce scaled up 25%.

name: Shield Slam
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Scales off own DEF instead of ATK/MAG. Shield bash that cracks the target's armour (Sundered) - a tank archetype that hits with its tank stat. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Warded Strike
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Scales off own RES instead of MAG. Draining strike that heals 20% of the damage dealt. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Bastion Strike
design_note: CHARGE - MC generic starter (tank-build fix). Scales off own DEF instead of ATK/MAG and hits as TRUE damage (ignores the target's DEF/RES entirely) at a flat 1.0x DEF against the WHOLE enemy side - lets a tank build convert its own investment straight into AoE damage. Flat power, no wave-based ramp.

name: Aegis Strike
design_note: CHARGE - MC generic starter (tank-build fix). Scales off own RES instead of ATK/MAG and hits as TRUE damage (ignores the target's DEF/RES entirely) at a flat 1.5x RES against a single foe. Flat power, no wave-based ramp.

name: Fleetstrike
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Scales off own SPD. Two quick hits; fires far more often than a normal charge action. Rare: power scaled up 25%. Power x5 compensates the 80% starting-SPD cut.

name: Battle Cry
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. A rallying cry - heals the party (scaled by own ATK) and Hastes everyone. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Font of Power
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. A MAG-scaled party heal that also grants Warded. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Bulwark Stand
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Shields one ally - heal scaled by own DEF, plus Bracing. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Calming Ward
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. A RES-scaled party heal that also cleanses one debuff per ally. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Fleet Step
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. A SPD-scaled party heal plus Hasted - a courier's trick, not a caster's. Rare: power scaled up 25%. Power x5 compensates the 80% starting-SPD cut.

name: Tideturn
design_note: CHARGE - RESOURCE/TEMPO. Buys turns deals nothing. Rare: no power field to scale (buff-only).

name: Last Light
design_note: CHARGE - REVIVE at 80%. Only full recovery in the game. Rare: no power field to scale (revive-only).

name: Sundering Vow
design_note: CHARGE - DEBUFF-first. Light damage strips DEF from everything. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Gravewind
design_note: CHARGE - TEMPO DENIAL. Slows every foe. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Reckoning
power_dynamic: 2.0 at full HP rising to 6.5 on a near-dead target
design_note: CHARGE - CONDITIONAL on target HP. Legendary: power scaled up 55% (the CSV power field is cosmetic here - actual damage is hardcoded in ACTION_DYNAMIC.reckoning in farroad-core.js, also scaled up 55% there).

name: Bulwark Oath
design_note: CHARGE - CHEAP/FREQUENT. Low rank fires often. Rare: no power field to scale (buff-only).

name: Ember Glut
design_note: CHARGE - RESOURCE. Doubles the whole party's charge rate to chain. Rare: no power field to scale (buff-only).

name: Hollow Toll
design_note: CHARGE - SUSTAIN-AoE. Heals caster 60% of total. Legendary: power scaled up 55%.

name: Sundering Roar
design_note: CHARGE - Stone Ox. Enfeebles the party.

name: Knit Bone
design_note: Enemy basic heal -- halved from 1.15 (Fen Priest was unkillable without a damaging charge action).

name: Colossus Slam
design_note: Super Boss reward (v2.20) - The Stoneheart Colossus, wave 750 tier. Unique: in CHARGE_ACTIONS (farroad-core.js) for pristine-snapshot/Lore-total support, but never in P.MC_CHARGE_DROP_POOL or any other random pool - only obtainable as this bosses first-clear reward. MC-only usable (charge actions have nowhere else to go for a companion) - granted into G.mc.acquiredCharges on first clear.

name: Reaper's Harvest
design_note: Super Boss reward. The Void Reaper, wave 1250 tier. Same uniqueness/MC-only rules as Colossus Slam. AoE dark damage with heavy self-sustain, echoing Hollow Tolls shape at a step above its own Legendary power.

name: Rockfall
design_note: Enemy basic - heavy slow Earth blow.

name: Talon Gust
design_note: Enemy basic - quick light Air strike.

name: Inferno
design_note: CHARGE - Pyre Tyrant. AoE Fire + Burning.

name: Undertow
design_note: CHARGE - Drowned Matriarch. AoE Water + Slowed.

name: Earthshatter
design_note: CHARGE - Mountain Colossus. Heavy single-target Earth.

name: Judgment
design_note: CHARGE - Dawn Seraph. Heavy single-target Light + Blinded.

name: Eclipse
design_note: CHARGE - Hollow King. AoE Dark + Frail.

name: Pyreblade
design_note: CHARGE - Tovan. Heavy Fire strike that sets the target Burning.

name: Tidebloom
design_note: CHARGE - Ilse. Party heal + cleanse + Regen.

name: Landslide
design_note: CHARGE - Garrow. AoE Earth that Slows every foe and taunts for 2.

name: Skyfall Volley
design_note: CHARGE - Wren. Five quick Air hits on one foe.

name: Dawnbreak
design_note: CHARGE - Lumen. AoE Light that Blinds every foe.

name: Nightfall
design_note: CHARGE - Vesh. Huge Dark strike with a big crit bonus and partial lifesteal.

name: Lightning Step
design_note: Scales with SPD; three quick hits.

name: Sanctum Ray
design_note: Scales with RES; hits every foe.

name: Bewilder
design_note: Confuses: its attacks may hit a random unit.

name: Worldsplitter
design_note: CHARGE - Kaldor (legendary). The biggest single blow in the game: armor-piercing, crit-heavy.

name: Starfall
design_note: CHARGE - Seraphine (legendary). Light on every foe; blinds them.

name: Thousand Cuts
design_note: CHARGE - Zephyra (legendary). Eight SPD-scaled air cuts.

name: Unbreakable
design_note: CHARGE - Bastian (legendary). Wards the whole party and taunts every foe.

name: Null Wave
design_note: CHARGE - Morwen (legendary). RES-scaled dark wave that dulls every foe.

name: Runeblade
design_note: Hybrid strike - power scales off the LOWER of ATK and MAG (so power is 35% higher than Strike to compensate).

name: Arcane Bolt
design_note: Hybrid bolt - hits RES; scales off the LOWER of ATK and MAG (power raised to compensate).

name: Ruin Wave
design_note: Hybrid AoE magic - scales off the LOWER of ATK and MAG.

name: Rune Cyclone
design_note: Hybrid AoE physical - scales off the LOWER of ATK and MAG. Rare: power scaled up 25%.

name: Harmony
design_note: Hybrid heal - scales off the LOWER of ATK and MAG (power raised to compensate).

name: Kindle
design_note: Gives an ally 20 charge. With no gambit aim it goes to the ally closest to firing.

name: Tithe
design_note: Gives up to 60 of its own charge to the rest of the party split evenly. Pair with Self: charge >= 50%.

name: Floodgate
design_note: CHARGE - Every other ally gains 30 charge. Chains the party into its own charge actions.

name: Ironquake
design_note: CHARGE - Iron Sovereign. AoE blow that Sunders every foe.

name: Soulrend
design_note: CHARGE - Hollow Oracle. AoE Spirit + Dulled.

name: Soulstorm
design_note: CHARGE - Lyrael (legendary). Spirit on every foe; strips their RES.

name: Hunt Down
design_note: Level-50 extra - Roadwolf. Runs down a wounded foe and Exposes it.

name: Raise Shield
design_note: Level-50 extra - Barrow Knight. Braces behind its plate when hurt.

name: Throat Rip
design_note: Level-50 extra - Mire Hound. A crit-prone finisher on a wounded foe.

name: Crushing Charge
design_note: Level-50 extra - Stone Ox. A slow, heavy charge that Sunders armour.

name: Fen Renewal
design_note: Level-50 extra - Fen Priest. Regen on a hurt ally.

name: Thorn Volley
design_note: Level-50 extra - Thorn Shrike. A volley of poisoned thorns, opening a fight.

name: Flame Wisp
design_note: Level-50 extra - Cinder Imp. Wisps of flame that Burn.

name: Tidal Hex
design_note: Level-50 extra - Tide Wraith. Hexes a foe with no debuff, leaving it Frail.

name: Seismic Stomp
design_note: Level-50 extra - Crag Golem. A stomp that Slows every foe, opening a fight.

name: Feather Flurry
design_note: Level-50 extra - Gale Harpy. Three quick hits on a wounded foe.

name: Dawn Ward
design_note: Level-50 extra - Dawn Acolyte. Wards an ally who is hurt.

name: Dusk Pierce
design_note: Level-50 extra - Umbral Stalker. Pierces 40% DEF; reserved for armoured foes.

name: Smoldering Brand
design_note: Level-50 extra - Pyre Tyrant. Brands every foe that lacks Burning.

name: Brine Veil
design_note: Level-50 extra - Drowned Matriarch. Regen on herself, when nearly beaten.

name: Tremor Stomp
design_note: Level-50 extra - Mountain Colossus. Sunders foes that are not yet Sundered.

name: Slipstream
design_note: Level-50 extra - Storm Roc. Blurs itself on its first turn.

name: Radiant Pulse
design_note: Level-50 extra - Dawn Seraph. Dulls foes that lack it.

name: Soul Siphon
design_note: Level-50 extra - Hollow King. Drains 50% of the damage back, when nearly beaten.

name: Crown Crush
design_note: Level-50 extra - Iron Sovereign. A crushing blow that Sunders, when hurt.

name: Prophecy of Ruin
design_note: Level-50 extra - Hollow Oracle. Frails foes that lack it.

name: Hide Hammer
design_note: Level-50 extra - Ironhide Brute. A slow hammer blow that Enfeebles a fresh target.

name: Hollow Chorus
design_note: Level-50 extra - Hollow Husk. A chorus that leaves the party Frail, opening a fight.

name: Carrion Feast
design_note: Level-50 extra - Rotted Carrion. Feeds on a foe to heal itself, when hurt.

name: Mass Veil
design_note: Level-50 extra - Veilwarden. Wards every ally, when one is hurt.

name: Mire Remedy
design_note: Level-100 extra - Fen Priest. Removes every debuff.

name: Inferno Burst
design_note: Level-100 extra - Cinder Imp. +50% damage to Burning targets.

name: Curse of Body
design_note: Body Bane - Body affinity -10. Status only.
